description: Shoresh gold set v3 (ref §6 amendments A1-A4). Positives were found by the pre-Shoresh matcher, so they measure recall only; false-positive rates come from the controls and the Linear B negatives. Criteria 2-5 use informative rows only (>= 3 consonants). Lexicon spellings of campaign values are rewritten in corpus signs (QI → *34); `lexicon_word` keeps the lexicon's spelling.
